description: The line plot illustrates the comparison of Macro-F1 scores for two different tokenization methods, MATTER and w/o material information, across varying numbers of tokens. The x-axis represents the number of tokens, ranging from 0.6 to 1.5, and the y-axis represents the Macro-F1 score, ranging from 48% to 58%. The MATTER method is represented by a pink line with circular markers, while the w/o material information method is represented by a purple line with diamond markers. The MATTER method generally shows higher Macro-F1 scores compared to the w/o material information method, with some fluctuations. The plot includes shaded areas around the lines, indicating the variability or confidence intervals of the scores.
